_comment: slab_diffusive.json with a VOID gap: the same 100-cell slab of ten mean free paths per cell at a scattering ratio of 0.99, with a Sigma_t = 0 gap over x in [4, 6], so two diffusive slabs that only talk to each other by streaming across the void. The 1D pin of the DSA's void masking: the void cells are masked out of the diffusion correction and each slab sees a Marshak face at the gap, so the correction does not couple the two slabs - the transport stages carry what crosses the gap.
